project_type: TradingView Pine Script v5 strategy (Smart Money Concepts / FVG). Single-file production script.
build_system: None. .pine files are compiled/backtested only inside TradingView's Pine Editor. There is NO local Pine compiler or backtester in this environment.
test_framework: None. Verification is by careful static reasoning about Pine v5 semantics only. The user re-runs the backtest in TradingView.
test_command: N/A (no local Pine toolchain). Verification = static Pine-semantics review + a semantic review pass.
verification_instructions: 1) Read the edited placeStrategyOrder and the header. 2) Confirm Pine v5 constraints: void functions end with trailing `true`; no break/continue; loops guarded; no reassignment of global scalars inside functions. 3) Confirm the exit tick math (loss=slPoints/mintick, profit=tpDist/mintick) still preserves the tpDist:slDist ratio. 4) Confirm opposite-direction entries can no longer net/close open opposite-direction trades at a non-SL/TP price. 5) Confirm unrelated behavior (structure, FVG detection, projection zones, dashboard, VWAP filter, entry modes, concurrency cap) is unchanged. 6) REMIND the user to re-backtest in TradingView.
setup_instructions: git checkout main && git fetch origin && git pull --ff-only && git checkout -b fix/rrr-consistency. Branch fix/rrr-consistency is ALREADY created and based on up-to-date main (a710062, which already includes PR #63 'remove Order Size input').
environment_constraints: Network mode: repository access via GitHub only. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator publishes). TradingView docs pages are JS-rendered and not fetchable; rely on established Pine v5 semantics. NO local Pine compiler, so no compile/backtest verification is possible.
contribution_requirements: Edit ONLY smc_fvg_strategy.pine at the repo root. Do not modify any other file. Keep unrelated behavior intact. Pine void-function constraints must be respected.
key_patterns: Orders are placed in placeStrategyOrder(bool isBull, nearEdge, farEdge) around line 410. Each signal calls strategy.entry(uniqueId, dir[, limit]) then strategy.exit(id+'_x', from_entry=id, loss=slTicks, profit=tpTicks). slTicks=slPointsInput/syminfo.mintick, tpTicks=tpDist/syminfo.mintick, tpDist = (tpModeInput==TP_RRR ? rrrInput*slPointsInput : tpPointsInput). Header: pyramiding=100, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, calc_on_every_tick=false. Orders are placed from BOTH bullish (placeStrategyOrder(true,...)) and bearish (placeStrategyOrder(false,...)) structure breaks in displayStructure(). A concurrency cap uses tradeOrders array + maxOrdersInput. tradeOrders also drives the on-chart projection (maintainTradeProjections) and must keep working.
directory_structure: Repo root holds several .pine indicators/strategies and SmcFvgBot.cs. Only smc_fvg_strategy.pine is in scope. .agents/tasks/ holds prior task state (context/reviews) that documents the from_entry / tick-distance exit design already in place.

root_cause_analysis.tick_ratio_not_the_cause: loss=slPoints/mintick and profit=tpDist/mintick preserve tpDist:slDist = rrr:1 regardless of unit. So the distance MATH alone does not explain inconsistent per-trade amounts. Confirmed; not the bug.
root_cause_analysis.primary_code_bug_opposite_direction_reve: Pine strategies hold a SINGLE net position. pyramiding=100 only stacks entries in the SAME direction. When market position is short and a long strategy.entry fires (or vice versa), Pine does NOT open an independent hedged long; the long order first CLOSES the open short entries at the long entry's fill price and then goes long. Those force-closed trades realize P&L at the reversal price, NOT at their own from_entry SL/TP, and their strategy.exit orders are cancelled with their entry. This decouples realized P&L from the configured 4pt/40pt distances and breaks the 10:1 R:R. It matches the reported data where all winners are shorts and all losers are longs with inconsistent amounts. This is the real bug.
root_cause_analysis.inherent_slippage_not_a_code_bug: A 4-point SL on XAUUSD (~4300) with calc_on_every_tick=false: market entries fill at next bar open and stop/limit exits fill at bar open when a bar gaps through the tiny level; a bar that trades through both SL and TP is assumed SL-first by Pine. A single gold bar often spans far more than 4 points, so realized fills exceed the level. This adds variance on top of bug #1 and is a settings/instrument reality (SL too small for gold's bar size), NOT a code defect.
root_cause_analysis.fix_direction: Gate order placement so an entry is only submitted when it does not conflict with an already-open opposite-direction position, preventing reversal-netting from closing opposite trades at a non-SL/TP price. Every filled trade then exits via its own from_entry SL/TP and realized R:R matches configured RRR for the normal (no-gap) case. Do NOT redefine the SL/TP unit. Document remaining inherent gap slippage.
